description.zh: CSSTransition 页 classNames 与 CSS 就是证明。 React Community 维护的进入/退出过渡组件库 react-transition-group，现为 4.4.5。仓库 LICENSE 标 BSD-3-Clause。它不自己做样式动画，只暴露阶段并管理 class。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by React Transition Group (https://reactcommunity.org/react-transition-group/).
Technology stack: react, javascript, css.
Component specification: CSSTransition 页 classNames 与 CSS 就是证明。

Visual details from source observation: 首页写明不是 React-Motion 那种动画库，只暴露 entering/exiting 阶段，并列出四个组件。TransitionGroup 页给 TodoList 沙盒，左边 index.js 引 CSSTransition。CSSTransition 页给 classNames 与 .my-node-enter。BSD-3-Clause 覆盖源码。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
